<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Coart (Messenger Devil)](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2907)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

The burning-winged coartis are marked by the onerous contracts they agreed to and bound to [Hell](/Planes.aspx?ID=42) by the machinations of a legalistic devil, usually a [phistophilus](/Monsters.aspx?ID=112). Some coartis are truly a type of fallen [celestial](/Traits.aspx?ID=551), those trapped in horrible agreements for the greater good or due to grievous errors in judgment, but most arise from mortal souls that were on the path to become celestials yet were contractually bound to Hell. Coartis serve in public roles as messengers and personal attendants to demonstrate the power of Hell and the legal acumen of their corruptors.

 Celestials universally pity coartis and despise their creators, but their preferred methods of dealing with the corrupted beings differ. While [angels](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=359) argue against lost cases in [Pharasma's](/Deities.aspx?ID=290) courts, seeking loopholes in the voluminous contracts, [azatas](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=368) scheme daring heists against the contract storehouses. [Archons](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=365) are the most direct, working to end their blighted lives.

<title level="2" right="Creature 7">[Coarti](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2907)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Medium" />
<trait label="Devil" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=575" />
<trait label="Fiend" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=600" />
<trait label="Unholy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=521" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 87

**Perception** +17; [greater darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59)

**Languages**
[Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Diabolic](/Languages.aspx?ID=117), [Draconic](/Languages.aspx?ID=2), [Empyrean](/Languages.aspx?ID=115); [telepathy](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=79) 100 feet, [_truespeech_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1728)

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +15, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +15, [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) +17, [Legal Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) +14, [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13) +17

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +4

**Dex** +6

**Con** +2

**Int** +3

**Wis** +4

**Cha** +4
</row>

**Items**
_+1 [morningstar](/Weapons.aspx?ID=363)_

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 24 

**Fort** +13 

**Ref** +17 

**Will** +15 

+1 status to all saves vs. [magic](/Traits.aspx?ID=644)
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 110

</row>

**Immunities**
fire

**Resistances**
physical 5 (except [silver](/Equipment.aspx?ID=379)), [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=669) 5

**Weaknesses**
[holy](/Traits.aspx?ID=517) 5 (see blood contract)

Blood Contract When the coarti takes damage from their holy weakness, blood flows freely from their eyes and the contract carved into their skin. They take 1d6 [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) and are [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=65) as long as the persistent damage continues, but their Despairing Shriek recharges.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 25 feet, fly 40 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
_morningstar_ +18 ([Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [Unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521), [versatile P](/Traits.aspx?ID=200)),
**Damage** 1d6+10 bludgeoning plus 1d6 spirit

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
wing +17 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521), [versatile P](/Traits.aspx?ID=200)),
**Damage** 1d6+7 bludgeoning plus 1d6 fire

**Divine Innate Spells** DC 25
- **4th**
[Darkness](/Spells.aspx?ID=59), [Translocate](/Spells.aspx?ID=1724) (at will)
- **Constant (5th)**
[Truespeech](/Spells.aspx?ID=1728)

**Rituals** DC 25

- **1st**
[Diabolic Pact](/Rituals.aspx?ID=143)

**Despairing Shriek** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([Divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=48), [Sonic](/Traits.aspx?ID=147), [Unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)) The coarti lets out a terrible cry, dealing 4d6 sonic damage to all creatures in a 30-foot emanation with a DC 25 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Will save. [Holy](/Traits.aspx?ID=517) creatures that fail this save are also [frightened 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76); this added effect has the [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=590), [fear](/Traits.aspx?ID=598), and [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647) traits. The coarti can't use Despairing Shriek again for 1d4 rounds.

**Wing Snap** <actions string="Single Action" />  **Frequency** once per turn; **Effect** The coarti makes two wing Strikes, then [falls](/Rules.aspx?ID=402) if it's flying. It can't Fly until the end of its turn.

</column>
